digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and DET code-review criterion
propositions: Bugs with persisted non-test file_impact must escalate from light advisory tier to full blocking rubric at both precheck and route_criteria seams, while bugs with test-only or missing file_impact remain in light tier.

Gerrit DET criterion must block bug-fix commits with non-test diffs exceeding 150 lines lacking current-or-code-drifted plan-review attestations, with cross-host verification against trusted environments.

Plan-review attestation verification must use cross-host opcert machinery (opcert_from_record → trusted_env_keyring → verify_opcert → compute_validity), never own-env plan_review_status/verify_opcert_record.

Attestation verdict disposition must accept {certified, stale-code, stale-head}, flag remaining compute_validity plan-review literals and {mismatch, key_not_valid_at_era, unknown_kind, unknown_scheme, invalid}, and fail open (advisory only) on {unavailable, error, unknown-future}.
Non-test line classification must exclude tests/** and conftest.py paths; threshold BUGFIX_SIZE_THRESHOLD=150 must be a single shared constant imported by both criterion and backtest.
Backtest over 113-commit planning corpus must flag exactly the 13 hand-adjudicated substantive commits with zero mechanical false positives.
